decision: routed to the figure-it-out playbook instead of the Feature playbook
why: this is a large cross-cutting change: six screens, an ARKit pipeline, a reminder state machine, a logger, a simulation harness, tests and a device install

decision: defined done as a device-installable app driven by a scripted scenario, plus green state-machine tests and a per-screen screenshot set
why: done has to be checkable against the real artifact, not a proxy

decision: committed the scaffold to main and pushed before any feature code
why: the brief asks for the scaffold on main first, and a reviewer needs the base to exist

decision: proved the unit-test target runs green before writing feature code
why: verification harness before features, so a later break is localizable to the unit that caused it

decision: froze the domain declarations and gave the implementation to one owner
why: four parallel implementers need one compiled contract first; declarations are identical in every slice

decision: built the current tree for the physical device to prove free-team provisioning early
why: signing and provisioning are the slowest unknown on the critical path

decision: confirmed build, install and launch all work on the iPhone 13 with the free team
why: the whole delivery path is now proven before any feature code depends on it
evidence: BUILD SUCCEEDED; devicectl install ok; process launch ok

decision: split the contract into four smaller units on flash-worker after the first owner produced nothing
why: the first delegate's model hit three consecutive length-stops on a large single-shot generation; smaller outputs and a different model is the fix
evidence: agent ContractOwner failed, exit 1, 12m38s, no files written

decision: all eight engine tests passed on the first run
why: the four slices compiled together with no interface drift because the declarations were copied from the frozen spec
evidence: commit fba7114, xcodebuild test: TEST SUCCEEDED

decision: mutation-checked the suite by changing the default gentle delay from 5 to 10 seconds
why: a suite where everything passes first time deserves a check that it can fail, otherwise the observation method is suspect
evidence: 6 of 8 tests red; green again after git checkout

decision: dropped a duration property that was going on the SampleSource protocol extension
why: protocol extension members dispatch statically, so reading it through an existential would have silently returned the default instead of the real value
result: removed before any code was written

decision: adopted the QA acceptance checklist and PRD v0.2 as the authority and respecified the log schema, scenarios and coordinator
why: the checklist arrived mid-build and conflicts with the v1 schema: it wants ts in milliseconds, snake_case keys present on every line, near/no_person/calibration_done vocabulary, seven screenshots and seven scenarios
result: v2 wave dispatched over four files
